name: The Rats of the Royal Sewers

text.offer: Pritchett says, "The Royal City's sewers are a disgrace. Rat soldiers the size of hounds, and a king leading them. The court wants them gone and the court pays me, so I'll pay you: fifteen soldiers, and their king."
text.progress: Pritchett says, "The way into the Sewers of Barloque is in the city. The king keeps to the deeper tunnels."
text.complete: Pritchett says, "The king too? The court will be pleased, and so am I. Here."

steps.objective: Rat soldiers slain in the Sewers of Barloque
The rat king of the Sewers of Barloque slain
steps.brief: Pritchett says, "Good. Now their king: he keeps to the deeper tunnels, with his soldiers around him."
